profile_text.body:
Helicone is an LLMOps platform that describes itself as providing AI gateway and LLM observability services for routing and monitoring AI applications. Its core product, also called Helicone, operates as a proxy-based gateway that allows developers to integrate logging, caching, and rate limiting into their applications through a single base-URL change. The company's site positions it as the platform behind fast-growing AI companies.

According to the held facts, Helicone was acquired by Mintlify in March 2026, and the product has been in maintenance mode since that acquisition. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded for the company in the available data.
